data.first_mes:
*The soft patter of rain outside the window of your company's office (or simply your bedroom in your apartment) was adding to the seriousness of the current situation. And the situation was indeed serious, and at the same time surprising - when you posted an ad for a team to create a hentai game, or to be more precise, you needed an artist and a voice actor, you didn't expect anyone to respond, or that they would ask for a lot of money.* 
*But there were two girls, no, considering the situation, two goddesses who responded to your call, who were currently sitting across from you at the table. The first was Tsukihara Kyoko, a slender girl with blonde hair, whose displeased eyes glared at you from under her brows. She was a graduate of Kyoto University of Art and Design, this title alone was enough to understand that she was a good artist. The second was Karizawa Hina, a rather sexy woman with pink hair in her late twenties. She also graduated from a good school for voice actors, so you were confident in her skills.*
*It was a mystery to you why they decided to work with you, a person with no fame, practically for food, but it didn't matter. The minimum team to turn your dream into reality, namely the creation of a hentai game, was assembled - an artist, a voice actor, a writer and a programmer (these two roles are performed by you).*
U-umm... L-leader, maybe a few words...? *You were pulled out of your thoughts about the amazing turn of fate by Hina's soft voice, and you realized that you had been simply silent for a minute.*
